findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy
findings.evidence: HTTP HEAD / returned 200; content-security-policy header absent.
findings.impact: Absent CSP may reduce mitigation against injected active content.
findings.limitations: Missing header alone does not establish exploitation; review actual endpoint and browser context.

findings.title: TLS certificate trust or identity validation failed
findings.description: TLS certificate trust or identity validation failed
findings.evidence: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: self-signed certificate (_ssl.c:1029)
findings.impact: Clients cannot establish authenticated server identity.
findings.remediation: Install a valid certificate chain whose SAN matches the assessed address; lab self-signed certificates are expected exceptions.
findings.limitations: Verification can also fail due to missing local CA trust or lab-issued certificates.

findings.title: No observed clickjacking framing restriction
findings.evidence: Neither CSP frame-ancestors nor valid X-Frame-Options present in HTML response.
findings.impact: The page could permit undesired framing.
findings.remediation: Set CSP frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options after checking intended embeds.
findings.limitations: Only sampled the root HEAD response; exploitability depends on page behavior.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options

findings.limitations: Missing header alone does not establish exploitation; review actual endpoint and browser context.

findings.title: Server header disclosed
findings.impact: Discloses a server identifier that may assist reconnaissance.
findings.remediation: Review whether a detailed Server header is necessary; patching matters more than hiding it.
findings.limitations: Server banner may be inaccurate; no version-specific vulnerability has been verified.

findings.title: Redirect observed (not followed)
findings.impact: A redirect destination may require a separate authorization check.
findings.remediation: Verify redirect destinations and secure transport manually.
findings.limitations: Redirect was intentionally not followed; destination not scanned.

methodology: Authorized IP-only TCP connect checks; passive banner sampling; HEAD / on known HTTP ports; verified TLS handshake plus clearly labeled untrusted certificate diagnostics.
limitations: Only configured ports and a single HTTP root response are checked. Service names are inferred from ports, not authenticated. No exploitation, CVE confirmation, weak-cipher enumeration, authentication, or subnet discovery. A clean scan does not establish system security.
source_note: Captured by record_demos.py against controlled loopback lab; not live.
